item: The rollup build reports its progress in the boot block, and the read model, incremental refresh and meta upsert take the bulk path
summary: Second rollup PR after #1310. The boot sequence's rollup step now shows the build's stage, rows streamed and rows/s (absent, never 0, when unmeasurable), and warns after the slow-step threshold with no progress, naming what waits behind it. The keyword read model streams by keyset in batches, and the incremental refresh and the meta upsert stage through the JSON bulk path instead of executemany. N14 (the no-token case) is tested and tests/test_rollup_serve_persisted.py joins the columnar CI lane (N16). The tier and total are left to the memory-tier PR.
